equation_summary: Block has TWO arrangement modes. Mode 1 (per-layer mixer selection, Block.__init__ lines 318-339): attn_layer_pos overrides; else periodic tests set use_mamba (idx%mb_per_layer==0), use_retnet (idx%ret_per_layer==0 -> MultiScaleRetention), use_gla (idx%gla_per_layer==0 -> GatedLinearAttention); unmatched layers fall to CausalSelfAttention. Mode 2 (mamba_swa_mlp, lines 310-314, 357-361): ONE block runs Mamba(norm_m(x))+x THEN attention(norm_attn(x))+x, two norms and two residuals in one block. Attention branch = softmax SDPA (causal, optional local window via flash_attn window_size) = U1.S; RetNet/GLA = U2.A; Mamba = selective SSM (separate axis).
state_shape: attention/GQA branch [B,S,H_kv,D] KV cache; RetNet/GLA [B,H,K,V] matrix state; Mamba selective-SSM state
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM ledger graph 'config-derived ordered Block list; each Block = E[norm]; selected mixer call(s)' and the worked configuration rule (section after 078) both match model.py Block with two modes
CONFIRM both arrangement modes from source: per-layer selection (320-339) and mamba_swa_mlp running Mamba then attention in one Block (357-361)
CONFIRM attention branch is U1.S (scaled_dot_product_attention / flash_attn causal, line 565-599), retention->MultiScaleRetention and GLA->GatedLinearAttention are U2.A
CORRECT Mamba branch is NOT U2.A; it is the selective-SSM law requiring the Mamba axis (A8), so the mamba_swa_mlp and use_mamba configs are gated on that axis, not merely B[K2_graph_execution]
axis: A8 selective SSM (Mamba axis) for the use_mamba / mamba_swa_mlp configs only
direction_justification: The attention/retention/GLA configs are plain U1.S / U2.A composition with config-derived scheduling, but any config that selects Mamba (including mamba_swa_mlp) is gated on the Mamba selective-SSM axis, so this split is recorded honestly.
